service: Hyper3D Rodin (hyper3d.ai), Business plan, through the hyper3d MCP server
prompt: A rolled-up rug: a long, thick cylinder of rug rolled tight, deep red with a big simple dark old-gold diamond pattern, tied with two thick cream cords, with a rounded spiral showing at each end. Hand-sculpted matte modeling clay, stop-motion claymation style, chunky rounded forms. One single closed object, no base, no text, no logos.

files.model.fbx: Rodin's base_basic_pbr.fbx; its embedded diffuse map is the final one, and its normal, roughness and metallic maps are flat 1-pixel images (flat normal, roughness 0.85, not metallic), so the clay stays matte

credits: Rodin reports no cost per call; about 0.5 credit a generation (T81's measurement). T105's total is in Docs/tasks/T105.md.
note: The diamonds came back bright mustard-orange (now Meta's seat color). fixtex.swift shifted the orange pixels to dark old gold (hue 37, saturation 0.74, value x0.72). My person chose this fix.
